capabilities.name: canonical-truth
capabilities.purpose: Resolve current canonical truth from immutable constitutional assertions.

capabilities.name: historical-truth
capabilities.purpose: Reconstruct canonical truth at earlier time or version boundaries.

capabilities.name: temporal-truth
capabilities.purpose: Resolve canon across temporal boundaries without rewriting history.

capabilities.name: context-hydration
capabilities.purpose: Project bounded canon context for authorized consumers.

capabilities.name: semantic-background
capabilities.purpose: Provide historical and semantic background from canonical sources.

capabilities.name: relevance-resolution
capabilities.purpose: Select relevant canonical material while preserving source provenance.

capabilities.name: supersession
capabilities.purpose: Resolve immutable truth evolution through supersession.

capabilities.name: canon-diff
capabilities.purpose: Derive deterministic differences between canon states.

capabilities.name: evidence-closure
capabilities.purpose: Traverse all evidence reachable from a canonical assertion.

capabilities.name: conflict-topology
capabilities.purpose: Expose unresolved and resolved canonical conflict relationships.

capabilities.name: resolution-topology
capabilities.purpose: Expose resolution relationships without independently attesting them.

capabilities.name: lineage-traversal
capabilities.purpose: Traverse canonical lineage and supersession ancestry.

capabilities.name: provenance-traversal
capabilities.purpose: Expose source and derivation provenance for canonical material.

capabilities.name: canon-feed
capabilities.purpose: Produce a rebuildable living stream of canonical change.

capabilities.name: explanatory-projection
capabilities.purpose: Explain why an assertion is current and how it acquired its present position.

capabilities.name: context-projection
capabilities.purpose: Generate bounded context packets from canonical primitives.
